notes.title: Bioneers combines factory-building with organism simulation in a microworld
notes.notes:
Bioneers will have you build up an organism on the micro-scale that mixes together elements of factory-building with organism simulation.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/bioneers-combines-factory-building-with-organism-simulation-in-a-microworld/
